title: Sutanu
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Sutanutīre || || 2. Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu || || Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || [page 298] 298 Anuruddha-Saṃyuttam LII. 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avocuṃ || || Katamesaṃ āyasmā Anuruddho dhammānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññātam patto ti || || 4 Catunnam khvāham āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññātam patto || katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || Idhāham āvuso kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || vedanāsu || citte || dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Imesaṃ khvāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññātam patto || || 5. Imesaṃ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā hīnaṃ dhammaṃ hīnato abbhaññāsiṃ || majjhimaṃ dhammam majjhimato abbhaññāsiṃ || paṇītaṃ dhammam paṇītato abbhaññāsin ti || ||
